messages.subject: SE for pooled densities
parts:
Dear list,

I=B4m trying to calculate density of aquatic birds in rice fields with=20=

different growing stages (I'll call them "habitats")that where sampled=20=

with different efforts. There are several questions I am trying to solve,=
=20
however, some of some issues remain unclear to me.

The survey was carried out using point transects of 500 meters between=20=

points. With an irregular number of points per transect and in some cases=
=20
there are complete points and other are half points (this is solved with=20=

the point effort at the points). Distances were measures using regular=20=

intervals of 10 m up to 150 m (grouped data).

Depending on the number of observations I pre and post stratify by=20
habitat to estimate avian density on each habitat (stratum). The problem=20=

is in obtaining the Standard Error for pooled densities (I need densities=
=20
per stratum and total. I've been searching for this issue in the mail lis=
t=20
and I read a similar problem with the subject: Estimating SE for pooled=20=

density estimates , by MILLER Cameron. I've read the answer but it remain=
s=20
unclear to me because I ticked the box under "stratum" and "global" and t=
he=20
SE for pooled density does not appear.=20
=20
Thank you!

Andrea.
